selection: Non-surface families only. Fixed seeded bucket order, first 120 eligible unique family/word units per language, then seeded category-diverse selection of 40; purposive preparation, never a population probability sample
category_labels: Coordinator-only discovery flags are hypotheses, never known VALID/INVALID labels; actual category sufficiency needs independent preflight certification

arbitration.selection: int(SHA256(canonical JSON [seed, question_id]),16) modulo 10 == 0; fixed before labels

qualification: External verified real-person identity, language competence, derivational/historical morphology experience, authorization and conflict-of-interest check; identifiers alone or self-attestation are insufficient
blinding: Separate access-controlled A/B delivery; exclude predictions, expected verdicts, risk/category flags, prior decisions and other responses. Preview files are not proof of independent delivery
threshold_origin: Agreement .90/.80 inherited from cleanup_quality/protocol.json; calibration adds procedural readiness requirements and does not change linguistic definitions or association formulas
timing: Timezone-aware start/finish plus nonnegative self-reported active_seconds <= wall duration; report mean/median and missingness separately; no invented human time
instruction_revision: Any substantive change creates a new protocol/instruction/dataset version and a new calibration round before main annotation; preserve both original responses, original packet and old holdout
